shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling, needs, work and storage come free from vanilla. Cross-level combat, senses, NPC travel, CE bridge (experimental), transit animations, finished-art blueprints (§74) + wall risers (§75 a/b/c fixes, c unlaunched). Workshop 3776015553. Owed: finish field pass, final riser art (Gemini paused r5), smoke test, notes-paste, §62.N/§70, upstream paste.

Keep every ⚠.

# As above, So below II (V2)

> V1 is DELETED from the tree (survives in git history pre-a50a744). ~117 .cs files, ~34,000 LOC. No em-dashes anywhere in shipped text.

# 0. START HERE

**CURRENT PHASE: §74+§75 FIELD TEST, MID-SESSION, RUN 3 LIVE.** This session: run 1 clean → §75.a (own-cell stub) fixed → 5 Gemini rounds failed → TEMP AGENT ART (12 PNGs, user-ordered rule-2 exception) + north-face uiIconPaths → run 2 → §75.b (up-cell stub on floor above) fixed → run 3 (LIVE NOW, has a+b+art) → **§75.c (during run 3): Pipe/Climate/Data risers show no connect toggles in a vanilla session - EXPECTED (only vanilla power exists as a host network; same is true of the columns) - but the inspect line advertised toggles that don't exist. Fixed (rules 31/33): new `TypeHasNetworks()` branch + Keyed `AB2_ColumnInspect_NoNetworks` ("No compatible {0} networks detected..."). Built 0w/0e DURING run 3 - cosmetic, user told to finish the pass first; lands next launch.** No [automated] errors across all three runs (= §74 tripwire silent). Workspace dll DEBUG. ⚠ Rule 29 (w9 residue): utility run + notes paste never separately confirmed.

**GIT:** `Astryls/As-above-So-below`, `main`, `eb3dad9` pushed. Autosave job active - harmless. §74/§75 work not manually committed; checkpoint next session if autosave missed it.

**⚠ OWED, IN ORDER:** (1) **Finish the run-3 field pass** (ledger 1d/1e; §75.b is the fresh piece under test; §75.c lands NEXT launch). (2) **COMPANION SESSION with the user's pipe/climate mods** (run_test_cycle companionMods, get packageIds via list_installed_mods): verifies §62.N (ledger 1b) AND lights up the non-power riser toggles in one session - natural next test. (3) **FINAL riser art - Gemini PAUSED r5** (camera-donor breakthrough; scale unresolved - use strip-width units; ⚠ REWRITE prompts + `docs/ART_KIT_WallRisers.md` to the REAL palette first: power=blue-grey steel+blue+hazard, pipe=pale+RED valve, climate=ice+louver+orange, data=black+purple+cyan; NO copper anywhere. Standing offer: mount round-5 slab at small drawSize). (4) **WORKSHOP SMOKE TEST** (3776015553, WORKSHOP copy; has none of §74/§75). (5) w9 notes-paste confirm. (6) Smooth Terrain upstream paste. (7) §70 Caverns verify (1c).

**⚠ SHIPPED KNOWINGLY UNVERIFIED (Workshop):** §62.N, §70 (w8); §62.M, §66c, §66e (w7). USER-VERIFIED: §72, §72.b, §71 baseline, §73. TREE ONLY: §74, §75(+a+b+c).

**⚠ USER WORKING RULES:** (1) NEVER source design ideas from other mods unless asked - scans COMPAT ONLY. (2) Building art = USER via Nano Banana kits; §75 temp set = explicit user-ordered TEMPORARY exception; render_svg_to_png otherwise = flat UI geometry only. (3) About.xml description = USER's copy. (4) N mockups = N CHOICES.

**What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities: visual clarity from above, performance, vanilla parity.

**⚠⚠ THE THIRTY-EIGHT RULES:** 1. CLAMP AT SELECTION. 2. NEVER PATCH `TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms`. 3. REGION CONNECTIVITY IS MORE OPTIMISTIC THAN THE PATHFINDER: flood CELLS. 4. COUNT EMITTERS/POPULATIONS/ENGINE STACKS. 5 (§48): A `Touch` TARGET IS USUALLY UNWALKABLE. 6 (§49): A VANILLA HELPER CAN BE A NO-OP INSTEAD OF AN ERROR. 7 (§52): THE CARVE IS NOT THE LAST WORD. 8 (§52.6): A LOAD-TIME REPAIR PASS MUST NEVER RE-CREATE WHAT THE PLAYER DELIBERATELY REMOVED. 9 (§53): SOME MISPLACEMENTS ARE NOT VISIBLE IN THE CELL. 10 (§54): A STRUCTURE IS NOT A CELL. 11 (§55): A CELL-LEVEL VERDICT CANNOT AUTHORIZE A PAWN-LEVEL ACTION. 12 (§56a): A FOREIGN MOD'S MAP-SIZE SNAPSHOT IS AN INPUT YOU CAN CORRECT. 13 (§56g): NEVER COPY A GRID YOU DID NOT WATCH BEING WRITTEN. 14 (§56m): BEFORE RELOCATING DATA, ASK WHAT IS ALREADY AT THE DESTINATION. 15 (§57i): ASSERT ALWAYS, NARRATE ON REQUEST. 16 (§56o): COUNT THE FOREIGN MOD'S WRITE PATHS. 17 (§56q): A PASSING RUN THAT DID NOT REPRODUCE THE FAILURE IS NOT A FIX. 18 (§57a): NEVER EXONERATE A SUSPECT ON ONE CLEAN SAMPLE. 19 (§57f): `TicksGame` RESTARTS AT 0 EVERY NEW GAME. 20 (§57g): MOVING WORK EARLIER TURNS ON EVERY "IS THIS MAP READY" GATE. 21 (§58): THE PARALLEL GRIDS DO NOT TRAVEL WITH THE CONTENT. 22 (§59): A DERIVED GRID HAS NO PAWN IN IT. 23 (§60): AUDIT THE WEIGHTING, NOT THE SYMBOL. 24 (§61a): CLAMPING A VALUE WITHOUT CLAMPING ITS TARGET BUILDS AN OSCILLATOR. 25 (§61b): A POSTFIX ON `Update` IS AFTER THE OBJECT WAS ALREADY POSITIONED. 26 (§61f): EVERY READ OF THE MAP THE PLAYER CAN REACH MUST PASS THE RENDERER'S "IS IT DRAWN" GATE. 27 (§62c): PREFER SPAWN/DESPAWN OVER FLICK. 28 (§63a): A PERMANENT FICTION INSTALLED FOR ONE SUBSYSTEM IS READ AS FACT BY EVERY OTHER ONE. 29 (§0b): REPORT OUTCOMES, NOT INTENTIONS. 30 (§66d): A FELT DURATION IS A CHAIN, NOT A NUMBER. 31 (§66f): MAKE THE GUARD SAY WHICH CLAUSE DECLINED. 32 (§69a): TURNING OFF A TICK TURNS OFF EVERY SERVICE THAT RODE ON IT. 33 (§62k): A FILTER THAT CAN REJECT EVERYTHING MUST SAY SO. 34 (§62l): AN INVISIBLE THING IS ABSENT FROM EVERY SECTION LAYER; MESH AND OVERLAYS ARE SEPARATE METHODS. 35 (§62n): A CLONED FOREIGN DEF MADE VISIBLE IS IN NONE OF THE HOST'S OWN LOOKUPS. 36 (§70a): RUN VANILLA'S OWN LEGALITY PREDICATE. 37 (§71a): NAME THE ENFORCEMENT POINT BEFORE NAMING THE SYMPTOM. 38 (§73): WHEN A SPRITE MUST APPEAR AWAY FROM ITS THING'S POSITION, OWN THE DRAW.
